Class DocumentStore<T>

java.lang.Object
xericker.xerlib.storage.DocumentStore<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class DocumentStore<T> extends Object implements AutoCloseable

Stores one serialized document per id, with optional mirrored copies for recovery.

Reads are synchronous and hit the backend directly, so they belong off the server thread. save(T) encodes on the calling thread and hands the write to a single background writer. The mirror is only written after a successful primary write: it is last-known-good, never authoritative, and never read for an absent primary document.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public LoadResult<T> load(UUID id)
      Reads one document from the primary, falling back to the mirror only when the primary copy is unreadable. Synchronous: call off the server thread.

    • exists

      public boolean exists(UUID id)
      Returns whether the primary holds the id, falling back to the mirror on backend failure. Synchronous: call off the server thread.

    • ids

      public Set<UUID> ids()
      Returns the ids the primary holds, falling back to the mirror on backend failure. Synchronous: call off the server thread.

    • loadAll

      public List<T> loadAll()
      Reads and decodes every document, falling back to the mirror only when the primary read fails. Synchronous: call off the server thread.

    • save

      public void save(T document)
      Encodes the document on the calling thread and queues a coalesced background write, so it never blocks on I/O. Throws StorageException once the store is closed.

    • delete

      public void delete(UUID id)
      Queues a background delete of the primary and mirror copies. Throws StorageException once the store is closed.

    • flush

      public void flush()
      Waits for the queued writes to finish, so it may block. No-op once the store is closed.

    • close

      public void close()
      Flushes the queued writes, then closes both backends. May block; repeated calls are no-ops.
